title: Neuromeka Indy7 Digital Twin — P0 MVP
design: Direction A — Control Room (dark industrial HMI); see plan section 8 + design/Main.dc.html

stories.title: Repo scaffolding + toolchain gate (neuromeka install verified)

criterionAmendments.original: Makefile has `dev`, `test`, `assets` targets; `make dev` starts backend (uvicorn, :8000) and frontend (vite, :5173) together
criterionAmendments.replacement: Repo-root `pnpm dev` / `pnpm test` / `pnpm assets` provide the dev/test/asset entry points; `pnpm dev` starts backend (uvicorn, :8000) and frontend (vite, :5173) together via concurrently; a Makefile mirrors the same three targets for POSIX/CI
criterionAmendments.reason: `make` is not installed on the target Windows machine and the plan mandates a Windows-native workflow, so a Makefile cannot be the primary entry point; npm-script entry points are cross-platform and were verified running here
criterionAmendments.evidence: `make --version` -> 'command not found'; `which make` -> no match. `pnpm dev` verified: curl :8000/api/health 200 and :5173 200 concurrently.

acceptanceCriteria: backend/pyproject.toml exists, managed by uv, pins fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pydantic, neuromeka, pytest, httpx-equivalent test client, websockets

`uv sync` in backend/ succeeds AND `uv run python -c "import neuromeka; from neuromeka import IndyDCP3"` exits 0 on Windows native (Python pinned to 3.12 via uv because neuromeka's grpcio deps have no 3.13+ wheels); WSL2 fallback documented as unused
frontend/ is a Vite React+TS project (pnpm); `pnpm install` succeeds; vite.config.ts proxies /api and /ws to http://localhost:8000 (server + preview)
Repo-root `pnpm dev` / `pnpm test` / `pnpm assets` provide the dev/test/asset entry points; `pnpm dev` starts backend (:8000) and frontend (:5173) together; a Makefile mirrors them for POSIX/CI
backend/app/main.py serves GET /api/health returning JSON {status:"ok", mode, connected, model}
Root README.md documents one-command run and the chosen backend execution environment (Windows native + uv-managed Python 3.12)
stories.notes: RK4 resolved: neuromeka 3.4.2.2 fails to build under Python 3.14 (grpcio-tools 1.59 has no wheel, needs pkg_resources). Fixed by `uv python pin 3.12` + requires-python >=3.12,<3.13. Import + inverse_kin/forward_kin/set_simulation_mode/get_control_data all verified present. No WSL2 needed.

stories.title: URDF asset pipeline (Indy7)
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/fetch_urdf_assets.py downloads indy_description/urdf_files/indy7.urdf and meshes/indy7/visual/*.stl from neuromeka-robotics/indy-ros2 (humble-indyDCP3)
The script rewrites every <mesh filename=...> in indy7.urdf to a relative path under robot/meshes/indy7/visual/ and writes the result to frontend/public/robot/indy7.urdf
After running the script, frontend/public/robot/indy7.urdf contains zero absolute (file:// or package://) mesh paths and every referenced .stl file exists on disk
frontend/public/robot/NOTICE.md records the upstream source and license
`pnpm assets` runs the script end to end
stories.notes: Verified: 14 mesh refs rewritten to relative, 0 absolute paths, 7 STL files present (Indy7_0..6, ~9 MiB total, committed for offline use). NOTICE.md written (BSD-3-Clause).

stories.title: Backend RobotService (IndyDCP3 + Mock, sim-mode forced, fallback)
acceptanceCriteria: app/robot/base.py defines RobotService ABC: connect(), get_pose()->PoseDTO, get_joints()->list[float], solve_ik(tpos,init_jpos)->list[float], forward_kin(jpos)->list[float], stream()->AsyncIterator[TelemetryFrame]

app/robot/indy.py wraps neuromeka.IndyDCP3; connect() calls set_simulation_mode(True) unconditionally; get_control_data() parsed into PoseDTO(p) and joints(q); gRPC calls run via asyncio.to_thread; connection failure raises RobotUnavailable
app/robot/mock.py implements the same ABC with a deterministic 6-joint sine trajectory and a forward_kin/solve_ik stand-in; no network
main.py lifespan tries IndyDCP3Robot(host, 3s timeout) then falls back to MockRobot; app.state.robot and app.state.mode ("real"|"mock") are set
pytest proves: (a) IndyDCP3Robot.connect() calls set_simulation_mode(True) [SDK mocked], (b) unreachable host -> app starts in mock mode, (c) no movej/movel call exists in any P0 code path (AST scan)
stories.notes: test_robot.py: 6 tests incl. test_indy_connect_forces_simulation_mode, test_factory_falls_back_to_mock, test_no_motion_commands_in_p0_code (AST walk for movej/movel/movec).

stories.title: Backend REST API (health/pose/ik/state)
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/health -> {status, mode, connected, model:"indy7"} (200)
GET /api/pose -> {x,y,z,rx,ry,rz} six numbers from robot.get_pose()
POST /api/ik {tpos:[6], init_jpos:[6]} -> {jpos:[6]} for a reachable target
POST /api/ik with an unreachable/singular target -> HTTP 422 {error:"ik_failed", detail} and the server does not crash
pytest tests/test_routes.py covers all four endpoints against MockRobot and passes; coverage of app/robot + app/api >= 70%
stories.notes: 16 pytest pass, total coverage 90% (routes 100%, telemetry_ws 91%, mock 97%, factory 91%, indy 61% - real-controller lines unreachable without hardware).

stories.title: Telemetry WebSocket (20Hz, multi-client)
acceptanceCriteria: GET ws /ws/telemetry streams JSON frames {q:[6], p:[6], ts} ; a single background task polls robot.stream() at TELEMETRY_HZ (default 20) and fans out to all connected clients
Slow clients get the latest frame only (maxsize=1 queue, drop-oldest)
pytest tests/test_ws.py: frame shape correct, rate 15-25 Hz over a 1s window, two concurrent clients both receive frames
Disconnect of one client does not stop the stream for others
stories.notes: TelemetryHub: one asyncio task, per-client asyncio.Queue(maxsize=1), drop-oldest on full. 4 ws tests pass.

stories.title: 3D viewer — Control Room theme (three.js + URDFLoader)
acceptanceCriteria: src/three/RobotViewer.tsx renders a three.js scene: PerspectiveCamera, OrbitControls, grid floor, ambient+directional light, ResizeObserver resize; dark background per design token
src/three/urdfRobot.ts loads /robot/indy7.urdf via urdf-loader (STL handled by its defaultMeshLoader); exposes setJoints(q deg) driving joint0..joint5 (deg->rad); URDF rotated Z-up->Y-up
src/three/jointTween.ts interpolates current->target joint arrays with cubic easing via requestAnimationFrame, cancellable
three and urdf-loader pinned to exact versions in package.json (three 0.169.0, urdf-loader 0.12.6)
`pnpm build` succeeds with 0 TypeScript errors; Playwright e2e confirms the canvas mounts and the rendered pose changes with live telemetry
stories.notes: Real Indy7 STL meshes render (see docs/screenshots/01-overview.png). Ambient teal joint markers + amber TCP marker. urdf-loader has no types -> src/types/urdf-loader.d.ts ambient decl.

stories.title: Instrument panel + IK integration + status (Direction A)

criterionAmendments.original: src/components/PosePanel.tsx renders TCP POSE (X,Y,Z,Rx,Ry,Rz) from p in a 3x2 grid using JetBrains Mono teal values, and a TARGET POSE 3x2 input grid + APPLY TARGET button (Space Grotesk); submit -> POST /api/ik with init_jpos=current q -> success triggers jointTween, failure shows an inline amber message and does not move the robot
criterionAmendments.replacement: src/components/PosePanel.tsx renders TCP POSE (X,Y,Z,Rx,Ry,Rz) from p in a 3x2 grid using JetBrains Mono teal values, and a TARGET POSE 3x2 input grid + APPLY TARGET button (Space Grotesk); the target inputs are seeded ONCE from the first live pose and thereafter owned by the user (a ⟲ SYNC button re-copies the live pose); submit -> POST /api/ik with init_jpos=current q -> success triggers jointTween, failure shows an inline amber message and does not move the robot
criterionAmendments.reason: The original criterion did not mandate a seeding strategy; the first implementation chose 'seed from live pose until the user edits', which races with 20 Hz telemetry and clobbers typed values mid-edit. The replacement pins the behaviour to seed-once + an explicit SYNC control (a strictly added requirement, not a relaxed one).
criterionAmendments.evidence: Playwright run showed textbox 'X mm' reset to the live value '68.3' immediately after a fill('5000'); test passed reliably after switching to seed-once + explicit SYNC.

acceptanceCriteria: src/hooks/useTelemetry.ts subscribes to /ws/telemetry, exposes q/p and a connected flag, reconnects with capped backoff (<=5s)

src/components/PosePanel.tsx renders TCP POSE (3x2, JetBrains Mono teal) and TARGET POSE (3x2 inputs seeded once + ⟲ SYNC + APPLY TARGET); submit -> POST /api/ik (init_jpos=current q) -> success tweens, failure shows inline amber IK message and does not move the robot
src/components/StatusBar.tsx / header shows wordmark, SIMULATION|MOCK badge, host, and LINKED / CONNECTING / RECONNECTING state per design section 8
App.tsx layout: 56px header, left flex-grow viewport with grid overlay + TCP/triad/hint overlays, right 388px panel; all colors from the Direction A token table (src/theme.ts)
`pnpm build` + tsc clean; Playwright e2e drives input+apply (model moves) and an unreachable target (inline IK error, no crash, no uncaught JS errors)
stories.notes: Matches design/Main.dc.html closely - see docs/screenshots/*.png. JointBars J1..J6 with -180..180 -> 0..100% mapping.

stories.title: Real-time mirroring + integration
acceptanceCriteria: src/hooks/useJointAnimation.ts: rendered joints follow telemetry q EXCEPT while a user IK tween is running (tween owns joints until it completes or is superseded)
With backend in mock mode the robot visibly animates from the telemetry (e2e asserts the J1 readout changes over ~1s)
docs/hardware-check.md covers connecting to 192.168.3.4 in simulation mode and verifying mirroring + forward_kin(q) vs /api/pose round-trip
pnpm dev brings the whole app up and the viewport mirrors telemetry end to end
stories.notes: Hardware step is manual (controller not reachable this session). Mock-mode mirroring proven by e2e + screenshots.
